# Rahul Tanwar

Rahul Tanwar is a Dubai-based multi-industry founder and entrepreneur building ventures across the UAE and India.

## Primary profile

- Official website: https://rahultanwar.com/
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/rahul-tanwar-350a13279/
- Markets: United Arab Emirates and India
- Areas: gaming, consumer beverages, apparel and textile manufacturing
